== Definition ==
The <code>DefaultFollowerToggleQuestScript.psc</code> source file header definition for this script.

<source lang="papyrus">
ScriptName DefaultFollowerToggleQuestScript Extends Quest Default
</source>


== Documentation ==
The <code>DefaultFollowerToggleQuestScript.psc</code> source file documentation comments for this script.

<source>
Attach to quest where you have a follower you want to control follower state on using conditions various triggering events.

You can also call this function to trigger a check and toggle accordingly:
CheckConditions()
</source>

{{Script_Object_Member_Summary
| title = FollowConditions_RequiredOutput
| script = [[SFM:Script-DefaultFollowerToggleQuestScript|DefaultFollowerToggleQuestScript]]
| name = [[SFM:Script-DefaultFollowerToggleQuestScript/FollowConditions_RequiredOutput|FollowConditions_RequiredOutput]]
| kind = Property
| flags = Const Auto
| returns = bool
| parameters = true
| documentation = What do FollowConditions need to evaulate for actor to become a follower?

	If true (default), actor becomes a follower when FollowConditions evaluate true
    if false, actor becomes a follower when FollowConditions evaluate false
}}

{{Script_Object_Member_Summary
| title = StopFollowConditions
| script = [[SFM:Script-DefaultFollowerToggleQuestScript|DefaultFollowerToggleQuestScript]]
| name = [[SFM:Script-DefaultFollowerToggleQuestScript/StopFollowConditions|StopFollowConditions]]
| kind = Property
| flags = Mandatory Auto Const
| returns = ConditionForm
| parameters = none
| documentation = ConditionForm that is evaluated for when the actor should stop being a follower.
NOTE: normally this will be THE SAME condition form as the FollowConditions (See StopFollowConditions_RequiredOutput below for why)
}}

{{Script_Object_Member_Summary
| title = StopFollowConditions_RequiredOutput
| script = [[SFM:Script-DefaultFollowerToggleQuestScript|DefaultFollowerToggleQuestScript]]
| name = [[SFM:Script-DefaultFollowerToggleQuestScript/StopFollowConditions_RequiredOutput|StopFollowConditions_RequiredOutput]]
| kind = Property
| flags = Const Auto
| returns = bool
| parameters = false
| documentation = What do StopFollowConditions need to evaulate for actor to stop being a follower?

	If false (default), actor stops being a follower when StopFollow_Conditions evaluate false
    if true, actor stops being a follower when StopFollow_Conditions evaluate true
	NOTE: A value of false (default) lets you use the same condition form for both Follow and StopFollow as a mutally exclusive toggle)
}}
